chapter_title: Geographical Perspective on Selected Issues and Problems

concepts.title: Urbanisation and Environmental Pollution
concepts.definition: About 55 per cent of the world's population now lives in cities and the share is projected to reach 68 per cent by 2050; this urban surge concentrates air, water and waste pollution, putting pressure on governments and environments alike.
concepts.key_idea: The projected rise in the urban share equals the 2050 estimate minus the present share.

solution_steps.explain: 55 per cent now, 68 per cent projected by 2050

concepts.title: Water Pollution and Diseases
concepts.definition: Untreated sewage and industrial effluents pollute rivers and groundwater, spreading water-borne diseases like cholera, typhoid, jaundice and diarrhoea; the poor bear the burden as they depend on polluted surface water.
concepts.key_idea: Safe drinking water is preventive medicine: every clean source removes a hospital queue.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy209.txt water pollution and water-borne disease sections
question_patterns: name the water-borne diseases linked to polluted water

solution_steps.explain: sewage and effluents enter rivers and wells, then households
cholera, typhoid, jaundice and diarrhoea ride polluted water
poor households without treated supply suffer the heaviest toll

concepts.title: Land Degradation, Drought and Desertification
concepts.definition: Land degradation from deforestation, overgrazing, mining and faulty irrigation combines with drought to advance desertification, especially in arid and semi-arid tracts; watershed treatment, shelter belts and grazing discipline are the checked remedies.
concepts.key_idea: Desertification is degradation's end state - restoring cover and moisture early is far cheaper than reversing dunes.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy209.txt land degradation, drought and desertification sections
question_patterns: list the causes of land degradation discussed

solution_steps.explain: tree loss and overgrazing expose soil; drought completes the conversion to desert
watershed works and shelter belts hold soil and moisture
early treatment prevents costly dune reclamation

concepts.title: Measures Against Environmental Issues
concepts.definition: Measures against environmental issues combine government action - pollution control boards, emission norms, afforestation programmes - with citizen measures like rainwater harvesting, waste segregation and public transport; awareness is the multiplier of all such measures.
concepts.key_idea: Laws set the limits, but daily choices of energy, water and waste decide the actual pollution load.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy209.txt government and citizen measures for environmental issues
question_patterns: list government remedies for pollution in India

solution_steps.explain: state agencies regulate; citizens change daily practice
norms, boards and afforestation programmes are state tools
informed choices multiply every formal remedy
